newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-KORDA PULLS OUT WITH BACK INJURY.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KORDA PULLS OUT WITH BACK INJURY.

text.p: Eighth seeded Petr Korda of the Czech Republic pulled out of the Rotterdam World Indoor tennis tournament on Friday with a back injury, organisers said.
The 29-year-old was due to play top seed Goran Ivanisevic of Croatia on Friday in the quarter-final of the $750,000 tournament but hurt himself in training on Thursday.
"It is an injury to his lower back. He can't bend over," tournament director Wim Buitendijk said.
Korda reached the quarter-finals by beating Moroccan Karim Alami 6-3 7-5 in the first round and Johan Van Herck of Belgium 6-3 7-5 in the second.

His injury meant Ivanisevic, who won the tournament last year, received a walk-over to Saturday's semifinals where he will play Korda's compatriot Daniel Vacek, who beat Italian Renzo Furlan 6-4 1-6 6-3 in their quarter-final.
